user.title: Connect Antigravity
user.description: A login flow started from Home Assistant does not work reliably for Antigravity (Google redirects back to the machine that started the login). Instead, sign in once locally in the Antigravity CLI/IDE, open its saved token file (e.g. `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/antigravity-oauth-token`), and paste the access and refresh token here.

data.project_id: Google Cloud project ID (optional, usually leave blank)

error.invalid_token: Google rejected the refresh token. Copy it again from the token file.
error.cannot_connect: Google cannot be reached right now.

abort.cannot_connect: Google cannot be reached right now.
abort.already_configured: This Antigravity account is already connected.
